summary: [fixture] Three controls show meaningful gaps from current to target. The MFA enforcement gap (ZTMM.IDENT.1) is the highest-leverage move and can land within Q2; macro-segmentation (ZTMM.NET.1) is a multi-quarter program. Existing CrowdStrike Falcon coverage gives device posture inputs that can shorten the device-posture-for-access work.

items.gap: MFA is partially implemented; admin/privileged paths still allow password-only fallback.
items.recommended_action: Roll out hard-token MFA for privileged accounts; deprecate password-only login on admin tooling; align with Duo + Entra MFA already in inventory.

items.gap: Network is flat north-south; macro-segmentation absent between production and corporate tiers.
items.recommended_action: Stand up policy-based segmentation between prod and corporate VPCs; gate east-west by service identity.

items.gap: DLP not enforced on the two most sensitive categories.
items.recommended_action: Configure Microsoft Purview DLP for PII and financial categories; tune false-positive rate before enforcement.
